svg.aria-label: Decision tree: if your steps run outside the JVM, if workflows are authored outside your codebase, or if the workflow is mostly moving data between systems, choose Kestra. If none of those apply, a library like JobRunr covers you.

text.font-family: Satoshi, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Satoshi, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Do any steps run outside the JVM?

text.font-family: Satoshi, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Python, shell, dbt, or a connector into another system rather than your own Java code

text.font-family: Satoshi, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Are workflows authored outside your codebase?

text.font-family: Satoshi, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: by data engineers or ops, in a UI, without waiting for your release train

text.font-family: Satoshi, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Is the workflow mostly moving data between systems?

text.font-family: Satoshi, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: S3 to Snowflake to Slack, assembled from connectors rather than written in Java

text.font-family: Satoshi, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Satoshi, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The orchestration reaches past your application,

text.font-family: Satoshi, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the platform earns what it costs to run.

text.font-family: Satoshi, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Satoshi, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The work is Java steps in one application,

text.font-family: Satoshi, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
